title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model captures noise in the data rather than the underlying pattern. Consider how the variance of a model might influence its tendency to overfit.

title: Bias and Variance
text: Remember that bias and variance are two components of the error in a model. High variance can lead to overfitting, while high bias can lead to underfitting. Think about how these components are balanced in each model.

title: Comparing Variance
text: Which model has a higher variance?

title: Impact of Variance on Overfitting
text: If a model has higher variance, is it more likely to overfit or underfit?

title: Connecting Bias and Variance
text: Consider how the combination of bias and variance affects the overall error of a model. A model with low bias and high variance might perform differently than one with high bias and low variance.
